  • App Limits (App 限额 / 应用限额) — daily or weekly time caps on individual apps or categories under Settings → Screen Time → App Limits. Time Limit sliders set how long an app or category can run before a limit reminder or block. Controls device behavior — does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Per-app vs per-category caps — limit one social app, cap all Games, or budget Entertainment for the week. Listing copy may reference which limit type your gallery shows; configuring OS limit rules is outside AppLocale scope.

App Limits-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Daily-cap marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general wellbeing guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe App Limits workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

App 限额 vs 应用限额 vs 每日限额

Apple's Chinese UI commonly uses App 限额 or 应用限额 for the App Limits feature name under Screen Time settings. 每日限额 fits when screenshots emphasize daily time budgets on specific apps. 使用时限 works when marketing frames show Time Limit slider UI rather than the Settings feature label. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual marketing scope and avoids conflating App Limits with Downtime block windows or Screen Time usage reports.

App Limits vs Downtime phrasing

App Limits cap how long apps run over hours and days — buyers searching for daily social-app caps distinguish this from Downtime (停用时间) scheduled block windows and bedtime locks. Match what your English listing and screenshots actually show.

App 限额 vs 屏幕使用时间 — per-app cap vs Screen Time hub

Apple's Chinese UI uses App 限额 for App Limits under Screen Time and 屏幕使用时间 for the Screen Time settings hub and usage dashboards. Listing copy should pick the term buyers recognize on screenshots — a Time Limit slider frame needs App 限额-friendly phrasing; a weekly usage chart frame belongs on the Screen Time guide, not here.

Per-app vs per-category limits

App Limits can target one app (e.g. cap TikTok at 1 hour) or an entire category (e.g. limit all Games to 90 minutes daily). Use the term your screenshot actually shows — mixing per-app and per-category vocabulary confuses buyers comparing your listing to iOS Settings labels.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need App Limits-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like App 限额, 应用限额, 每日限额, and 使用时限 each signal different intent from Downtime, Focus mode, or generic parental-control keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Set App Limit" headlines on gallery frames — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.
